api.facade: vigilode::{Problem, Jacobian, Options, Atol, InteriorError, Rodas5p, Status}; Problem::new(n, rhs).jacobian(...).autonomous(); Rodas5p::capabilities(&problem, &opts); Rodas5p::solve(&problem, (t0,t1), &y0, &opts)
api.jacobian: Dense(row-major n*n), Banded {lower,upper,fill}, Jvp, FiniteDifference; grouped finite difference of declared band costs min(lower+upper+1,n)+1 RHS instead of n+1 dense. Analytic band callback costs no basis-JVP assembly.
api.options: rtol=1e-6, atol=Scalar(1e-9), h0=1e-3, max_steps=100000, dense_output=false, interior_error=WFilteredEnforce, tier=Protected by default. Atol::Vector supported on dense/banded fast routes, refused on matrix-free or sequential route.
api.routing: Tier::Performance currently runs precisely Protected. Banded fast preserves O(n bandwidth^2) factoring; mass or InteriorError::Enforce sequential dense may assemble band into O(n^3) LU. JVP-only route lacks dense output/mass/vector atol. Dense output WFilteredEnforce is an estimate and costs one RHS/backsolve per step, not a full global error certificate.
api.failures: After partial run, solve returns Ok(Solution{status: Failed,...}) with partial output/work; caller must check status/ensure_success. Typed Unsupported before step.
